report.explanation: All 12 gateway checkout observations returned HTTP 200 with durations 47-297ms; traces show every checkout span completing ok with 200s across order, inventory, payment, and postgres. Metrics show zero 502s on /v1/checkout. No error, latency, pool-exhaustion, or memory-leak signal is present in current evidence, so no bounded root cause is established. The excluded logs read is missing evidence, not proof of fault.
